about: Chapters of the main open textbooks on the LibreTexts bookshelves (chemistry, physics, mathematics, statistics, biology, geosciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities, business, medicine), one entry per chapter, weighted toward subjects OpenStax covers thinly.
collected: Crawled 2026-11-11 from the Bookshelves index of each LibreTexts library (https://{chem,phys,math,stats,bio,geo,eng,socialsci,human,biz,med}.libretexts.org/Bookshelves) and its sub-shelf pages; each book cover page gave the chapter list (its table-of-contents listing), the author (page Author classification or the "authored, remixed, and/or curated by" line) and the license (the "shared under a ... license" line). Books whose top level is only Part/Unit containers were expanded one level. Selection: every book (up to 15 per shelf) on shelves for geosciences, ecology, engineering (electrical, mechanical, materials, civil, environmental, networks), linguistics, music, art, theatre, dance, education, logic, philosophy, abstract algebra, analysis, geometry, combinatorics, probability, anthropology, history, religion and classics; up to 4 books per other shelf, introductory titles first. Skipped lab manuals, exercise/homework collections, Supplemental Modules, Spanish-language shelves, under-construction shelves and LibreTexts mirrors of OpenStax books.
